title: ME60405: Automatic Control
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction; Mathematical models of physical system; Feedback characteristics
of control systems; Control systems and components; Time response analysis,
design specifications and performance indices; Concepts of stability and
algebraic criteria; Root locus technique; Frequency response analysis;
Stability in frequency domain; Introduction to design; State variable analysis
and design.
